allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Emami Realty Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 29 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that a meeting of the Finance Committee of the Company will be held on Wednesday, 8thApril 2026, inter-alia, to consider and approve allotment of equity shares pursuant to the conversion of outstanding warrants, in accordance with the provisions of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 and other matters incidental thereto. '.
